dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: (This grand mead hall is located at the very top level of Piramida. It is here that banquets are often held following hard-won victories.)

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: (It is both a celebration of the renewed triumph of the lights of Nod-Krai over the long night, and a remembrance for comrades who shall no longer greet the dawn with us.)

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: (While the banquet's general form can be traced back to the Snezhnayan court of old, the passage of time has long since transformed its substance beyond recognition.)

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: (The only thing that has remained unchanged is the custom of offering the first pour of the feast to the dearly departed.)

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: (Life is short and fleeting, and only death is eternal.)
